ns2:section.sectionText: Doctoral Seminar. Explores the notion of authenticity. Modules will include authenticity in the archive, including issues of provenance, data integrity, digital curation, preservation, reliability, and trust; authenticity of texts, including issues in textual criticism, critical editing, philology, critical code studies, authors, and intentionality; and authenticity in art, including issues of originals and reproductions, curatorial practice, performance, and performance documentation. Related concepts include trustworthiness, evidence, proof, forgeries, facts, facsimiles, and simulation. Readings shall be wide-ranging and cross-disciplinary. Final seminar paper required.
